objective: Execute an actual PipeWire server plus pipewire-pulse compatibility surface, create one virtual/null sink, capture its monitor, inject an old packet stream, causally cancel that playback, and measure post-cancel old-packet residual before a replacement packet is delivered.
input_signal_law: Deterministic packet-tagged PCM probes are allowed only for target-surface transport/cancellation measurement. They mint no ASR, TTS-model, semantic, physical-speaker or human-heard credit.

predeclared_inflight_policy.rationale: One bounded 100 ms transport drain is predeclared before execution; the following 500 ms must not retain material old-packet spectral energy. This is a target-surface falsifier threshold, not a physical acoustic guarantee.

required_observables: old playback start and cancel monotonic timestamps
old-tone spectral RMS after the declared drain window
replacement-tone spectral RMS after replacement starts
all command exit codes and process termination observations
acceptance: NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE only if the actual PipeWire-backed virtual sink and monitor are proven present, old signal is observed before cancel, the old playback process is causally terminated, post-drain old-tone RMS ratio is <= 0.01 during the predeclared 500 ms observation window, and replacement signal is subsequently observed. Any old-tone residual above threshold after the bounded drain is PRODUCT_NEGATIVE at this target-surface cancellation scope. Setup/transport inability is INFRA_AUTH_TRANSPORT_QUOTA or EVIDENCE_INVALID, never a product negative.
next_exact_action: Execute exactly once against the exact commit containing this claim. Do not redispatch while nonterminal. Reconcile only measured PipeWire virtual-sink/monitor cancellation-readback scope.
